hero.title: PRO-KID Tool
hero.description: Help children and youth share how they feel so their care team can better understand what matters most.

language.title: Choose your language
language.description: Switching language updates the full PRO-KID tool instantly without reloading the page.

age.title: Choose the age group
age.description: Your selection determines which questionnaire JSON file will load later.

instructions.title: Completion instructions
instructions.description: Complete the questionnaire using the instructions below.

items.pastWeek: Tell us about feelings only during the past 7 days.
items.frequency: Please tell us how often each feeling occurred (frequency).
items.impact: Please tell us how much each feeling bothered you or your child (impact).
items.report: You can download or print a report afterwards.

age2To4.description: A proxy-report version for very young children based on caregiver observations.

age5To7.description: A shared-report version that supports early school-age children with guided help.

age8To18.description: A self-report version for older children and adolescents to describe symptoms directly.

questionnaire.title: In the past week, how often did you have this symptom?
questionnaire.subtitle: And how much did it bother you?
questionnaire.notice: Please answer every question. There are no right or wrong answers.

validation.completeDescription: This symptom has both frequency and impact responses.
validation.incompleteDescription: Select a frequency and an impact response to complete this symptom.
validation.needsAttention: This symptom still needs responses before your review is complete.

review.title: Review Answers
review.description: Check completion before generating a report. You can jump directly to any unanswered symptom.
review.allComplete: All symptoms are complete and ready for report generation.
review.incompleteDescription: Use the buttons below to jump to unanswered questions and finish your review.
review.validationNotice: Please complete the highlighted symptoms or review the missing responses before generating the report.

about.title: About This Tool
about.description: PRO-KID is a validated questionnaire that asks about symptoms and how much they bother you in the past 7 days.

items.two: For each feeling, choose how often you had it.
items.three: Then choose how much it bothered you.
items.four: There are no right or wrong answers.

scoring.title: Scoring Explained
scoring.description: Your answers are turned into scores from 0 to 100. We calculate two scores: how often you had symptoms and how much they bothered you.

privacy.title: Your Privacy Matters
privacy.description: Your answers are not saved or stored on our servers. You can download or print your results to share with your care team.

results.title: Your Results
results.description: Generate a report to calculate frequency and impact scores from your completed responses.
results.emptyState: Generate a report to calculate frequency and impact scores.
results.disclaimer: This report summarizes your questionnaire responses and is intended to support conversations with your healthcare team. It does not provide medical advice or a diagnosis.

validation.moreNeeded: More responses are needed before a score can be calculated.

symptomSummary.title: Symptom Summary
symptomSummary.description: Symptoms are sorted by highest reported burden to help clinicians quickly identify the most important symptoms.
symptomSummary.empty: Complete responses to view the highest-burden symptom summary.

actions.startNewAria: Start a new assessment and clear current answers
